reuse.why: Builds on the tree's WeekendRule/applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay abstraction and adds one shared isNonWorkingDay predicate used everywhere, but the daily-skip rule is not folded into that abstraction.

duplication.why: The 'daily skips, others move' dispatch (skipDailyWeekends filter plus applyWeekendRule with skipWeekend && !daily) is copied between getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange and re-derived again in getNextDate and schedule-template.ts.

placement.why: Holiday matching and moving live in shared/schedules.ts as they should, but the frequency-based skip policy is decided in server/schedules/app.ts and server/budget/schedule-template.ts instead of the shared weekend rule.

scope.why: Edits are limited to schedule date logic, the new handler, types, tests and release notes for the four steps.

maintainability.why: Holidays are cleanly shared, but four call sites each know that daily schedules skip, and ad-hoc lookahead sizes (7*(n+1)*8, 7*(count+n)*2, 2+3n) are scattered without one owner.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts compute the daily case themselves and pass skipWeekend: skipWeekend && !daily into WeekendRule instead of the rule deciding skip vs move.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip dispatch appears as skipDailyWeekends in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, as isDaily in schedule-template.ts, and as a frequency === 'daily' early branch in getNextDate.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend gain holidays, the recur schedule data gains frequency; getNextDate gains a daily special case; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template.ts steer the rule by masking skipWeekend for daily schedules.
